brief:
The International Committee of the Red Crescent confirmed that visits to Palestinian prisoners held in Israeli detention facilities remain suspended, with no resumption in place, Shehab Wire reported. The committee stated that no visits to detainees are currently scheduled and indicated no timeline for when access might be restored.

The suspension continues to restrict family contact with Palestinians imprisoned under Israeli authority. The committee did not elaborate on the specific circumstances triggering the halt or provide conditions under which visitation might recommence. Red Crescent officials previously facilitated regular prison visits as a humanitarian service monitoring detainee conditions and maintaining family ties.
